notes: BUB1B compound heterozygous (MVA1). Allele 1: NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter, nonsense exon 17/23, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic for Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1 (multiple submitters, no conflicts), LOFTEE HC, gnomAD ~3e-5. Allele 2: NM_001211.6:c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys, missense last exon, absent from gnomAD, AlphaMissense 0.92 (likely pathogenic); the amino-acid change is listed in ClinVar as VUS. Phase not experimentally confirmed (variants 10.9 kb apart, not read-phased in the GATK VCF); trans inferred from disease presentation. Phenotype (rhabdomyosarcoma, IUGR, short stature, nephrocalcinosis, parental recurrent pregnancy loss) matches BUB1B/MVA1; Phen2Gene ranks BUB1B first among the MVA panel for the HPO profile.
